title: Cranberry Sauce

drivers.name: TikTok trend
drivers.evidence: Single past week (2026-09-28) with $2.91 price and no promotion sold 22 units (x2.42 vs baseline). No prior TikTok-driven sales recorded. Noise-adjusted effect shrunk toward 1.0. One data point, high uncertainty.

drivers.name: Price increase
drivers.evidence: Price rose 2.1% from $2.85 to $2.91. Past price changes show demand sensitivity; no prior data at this price point. Estimated downward effect based on typical elasticity and noise-adjusted price response.

adjustment.analysis: The baseline median is 9.1. No events or promotions are planned. The price is up 2.1% (to $2.91), which typically suppresses demand. The product is trending on TikTok, a novel driver with no past data. Past promotions had median uplift x1.53 but noise-adjusted to x1.0, suggesting limited lasting effect. The recent week with $2.91 (2026-09-28) sold 22 units (x2.42 vs baseline), but that week had no promotion, possibly driven by TikTok buzz. This is a single occurrence, so evidence is thin. A price increase likely lowers demand, but TikTok trend may offset it. Combined, effects are uncertain. Shrink toward 1.0. No post-promo dip expected. No store closure.

brief:
PRODUCT: Cranberry Sauce | category Grocery | Store #12 (Austin, TX)
TARGET WEEK: 2026-11-09 to 2026-11-15 (5 weeks after the last week with sales data)

KNOWN PLAN FOR THE TARGET WEEK:
  events: none
  shelf price: 2.91 (+2.1% vs regular price 2.85)
  planner notes: Product is trending on TikTok

STATISTICAL BASELINE (exponential smoothing of recent sales; it ignores events, promotions and prices):
  median 9.1 | 5%-95%: 0.0 - 20.4 | 10%-90%: 1.5 - 17.8

In the evidence below, 'vs baseline' = actual units / what this same baseline predicted for that week.
It is the multiplier that would have been right, so it maps directly onto median_multiplier.
This product's ordinary weeks already swing about +/-81% around the baseline, so a past effect smaller than that, seen only a few times, is mostly noise. The
'noise-adjusted estimate' is the effect shrunk toward x1.0 for that noise and the number of sightings.
